traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria in docs/stories/010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT.story.md are satisfied: - @supports parsing and format validation are fully implemented in valid-annotation-format via the valid-implements-utils helper and covered by targeted tests. - Deep validation that each requirement listed in @supports exists in the specified story file is implemented in valid-req-reference, with explicit handling for @supports and tests covering both valid and invalid cases, including path security. - require-story-annotation and require-req-annotation rules both treat @supports as satisfying their respective annotation requirements while preserving existing @story/@req semantics; this is verified by dedicated tests. - Mixed usage of @story, @req, and @supports within the same comment and codebase is explicitly supported and tested. - Error messages for @supports format and missing requirements include the relevant story path and are validated by tests. - Requirement IDs are scoped per story file via a per-path cache, enabling ID reuse across stories; multi-story fixtures with shared IDs confirm this behavior. - Documentation and ADR 011 reflect and justify the @supports design, and no remaining code depends on the old @implements tag. Given the comprehensive implementation, explicit story-linked tests, and passing test suite, this story is fully implemented.
